note.question: How does the plan of one insurer affect the quality competition between two hospitals?
note.overview: The model considers the quality competition between two hospitals under the plan of one insurer. The insurer aims to maximize the overall achievable quality in the system by selecting either the fee-for-service (FFS) or the bundled payment (BP) scheme to compensate each hospital. The demand, the costs, and the probability of successfully treating patients depend on a hospital’s chosen quality.
